name: Romesoft JSON-LD & Indexing Toolkit
author: romelir

sections.description:
Romesoft JSON-LD & Indexing Toolkit is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress SEO and indexing suite that gives you full control over your site’s structured data (Schema.org), XML sitemap, robots.txt, 301/302 redirections, IndexNow instant indexing, and crawl budget optimization — all from a clean, modern administration interface.

Structured Data (Schema.org / JSON-LD)

Configure and automatically inject valid JSON-LD structured data into your posts, pages, and custom post types. Supports the most widely used schema types recognized by Google:

  • Article — For blog posts, news articles (NewsArticle), and editorial content (BlogPosting).
  • Product — Full WooCommerce integration with enrichments for brand, GTIN, MPN, and item condition, plus standalone Product schema mode.
  • Recipe — Complete cooking schema with prep/cook/total times (ISO 8601), yield, category, cuisine, nutrition calories, ingredients, and step-by-step HowToStep instructions.
  • Review — For review and rating content (Rating, itemReviewed, reviewer, and summary).
  • FAQPage — Structured questions and answers with support for unlimited additional FAQ items.
  • Local Business — Supports general and specialized business subtypes (Restaurant, Store, MedicalBusiness, LegalService, etc.), PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates, telephone, and price range.

Global Automatic Schemas:

  • BreadcrumbList (Breadcrumbs) — Automatically generates hierarchical breadcrumb structured data across singular posts, hierarchical pages, custom post types, and category/taxonomy archives.
  • WebSite & Organization — Automatically injects WebSite (including Sitelinks SearchAction) and Organization (logo and social media sameAs profiles) on your front page.

JSON-LD Preview & Google Rich Results Test:

  • Built-in JSON-LD Preview & Test tab inside the post editor metabox lets you inspect the exact <script type="application/ld+json"> output, copy it to your clipboard in one click, or open the live URL directly in Google’s official Rich Results Test.

Per-Post Indexing, Meta Robots & Canonical Control

  • Set per-post noindex and nofollow directives using WordPress’s native wp_robots API.
  • Define a Custom Canonical URL per post or page when syndicating or consolidating content.
  • Automatic Synergy: Posts marked as No Index are automatically excluded from your sitemap.xml and skipped by IndexNow pings.

Customizable XML Sitemap

  • Generate a physical sitemap.xml file in your WordPress root directory with a single click.
  • Content Filters: Choose which public post types and public taxonomies (categories, tags, product categories, etc.) to include.
  • Auto-Regeneration: Automatically updates whenever content is published, updated, or unpublished/trashed.
  • Avoid Duplicate Sitemaps: Includes a toggle to disable WordPress’s built-in virtual sitemap (/wp-sitemap.xml).

Robots.txt Manager

Create and manage a physical robots.txt file following Google’s robots.txt specification:

  • Disallows common WordPress admin and sensitive paths for all crawlers.
  • Explicitly allows Googlebot access to CSS and JavaScript files for proper rendering.
  • Includes a Sitemap: directive pointing to your sitemap.xml URL.
  • Edit the content directly from the built-in code editor in the administration panel.

IndexNow Integration

  • Automatically ping Bing, Yandex, and other participating search engines the moment you publish or update public content.
  • Dynamically generates and virtually serves your verification API key (/{api-key}.txt) without cluttering your root directory.
  • Manual URL Submission: Instantly submit any URL or relative path from your site on demand.
  • Recent Pings Log: Monitor timestamps, submitted URLs, and HTTP response status codes directly from your dashboard.

Redirections Engine

  • Manage 301 (Permanent) and 302 (Temporary) redirects directly from your WordPress admin.
  • Auto-Redirect 301 on Slug Changes: Automatically creates a 301 redirect whenever a published post, page, or custom post type changes its URL slug or parent page — complete with infinite-loop prevention and redirect chain flattening.
  • CSV Import & Export: Bulk-import redirects from a .csv file or export your entire redirection table for backups and site migrations.

Server, Crawl Budget & Maintenance Tools

  • 404 Error Monitor — Logs broken URLs, hit counts, timestamps, and referring sources. Includes a Create Redirect button on every row to fix broken inbound links in one click (and automatically clears the 404 entry once redirected).
  • Alt Text Audit — Lists media library images missing the alt attribute. Includes a smart Auto-Fill Empty with Clean Titles button and batch-saving to improve accessibility and image SEO in seconds.
  • Crawl Budget & <head> Optimization — One-click switches to 301-redirect thin media attachment pages, add noindex, follow to internal search result pages (/?s=), strip unnecessary <head> metadata links (wp_generator, RSD, WLW manifest, shortlinks), and disable secondary comment RSS feeds.
  • Environment Utilities — Safely flush rewrite rules (permalinks) and clear expired database transients.

External Services

This plugin can optionally connect to the official IndexNow API (https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow) to notify participating search engines when content is published, updated, or manually submitted.

  • When it connects: Only when the administrator explicitly enables the “Enable Auto-Ping” toggle or submits a URL via the “Manual URL Submission” form in JSON-LD Toolkit → IndexNow.
  • Data sent: Your site’s hostname, your generated IndexNow verification key, the public verification key URL on your site, and the URL(s) being submitted for indexing. No personal user data or visitor data is ever transmitted.
  • Service details: Provided by the IndexNow initiative. Please refer to the IndexNow Terms and Documentation and IndexNow FAQ for more information.

Key Features

  • Clean, object-oriented PHP architecture — zero bloat.
  • Secure form handling with capability checks and WordPress nonce verification on all write operations.
  • Uses WP_Filesystem for all physical file read/write operations.
  • Automatic database table initialization and upgrade handling.
  • Clean uninstallation routine (uninstall.php) that removes plugin data upon deletion.
  • Follows WordPress coding standards and is fully internationalization-ready (i18n).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the romesoft-seo-indexing-toolkit folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to JSON-LD Toolkit in the admin menu to configure per-post-type schemas and global schemas (BreadcrumbList, WebSite, Organization).
  4. Go to JSON-LD Toolkit → Sitemap to select included post types/taxonomies, optionally disable /wp-sitemap.xml, and click Generate Sitemap.
  5. Go to JSON-LD Toolkit → Robots and click Generate robots.txt to create or customize your physical robots.txt file.
  6. Go to JSON-LD Toolkit → Redirections to manage 301/302 redirects, enable automatic slug-change redirects, or import/export CSV files.
  7. Go to JSON-LD Toolkit → IndexNow to enable instant search engine pings or submit URLs manually.
  8. Use JSON-LD Toolkit → Tools to optimize your crawl budget, monitor and redirect 404 errors, batch-update missing image alt texts, refresh permalinks, or clear transients.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin conflict with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

This plugin is designed to work independently. If you have another SEO plugin active that also injects structured data or generates sitemaps, you may end up with duplicate output. We recommend disabling the overlapping modules in your other SEO plugin if you use this toolkit for those features.

Will the sitemap update automatically?

Yes. Once sitemap.xml has been generated for the first time, it is automatically regenerated whenever you publish, update, unpublish, or trash a post, or when you save new sitemap content filters. Posts marked as No Index are automatically excluded.

What happens when I change the URL slug of a published post?

When Auto-Redirect Slug Changes is enabled (active by default under JSON-LD Toolkit → Redirections), the plugin automatically creates a 301 redirect from the old URL path to the new permalink, flattens existing redirect chains, and prevents redirect loops.

What schema types are supported?

Article (Article, NewsArticle, BlogPosting), Product (with WooCommerce enrichment and standalone mode), Recipe, Review, FAQPage, and Local Business (including specialized subtypes), plus automatic global BreadcrumbList, WebSite, and Organization schemas.

Can I preview or test my JSON-LD before publishing?

Yes. Inside the post editor metabox, open the JSON-LD Preview & Test tab to inspect the formatted JSON-LD code, copy it to your clipboard in one click, or test the URL directly in Google’s Rich Results Test.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. WooCommerce integration is optional. The plugin enriches WooCommerce’s native Product schema if WooCommerce is active, or can generate standalone Product schema on its own.

What happens if a physical robots.txt already exists on my server?

The plugin detects the existing file and allows you to view and edit it in place, or regenerate it with the recommended defaults after confirmation.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Feature: Added complete schema generators and metabox fields for Recipe, Review, FAQPage, Local Business, and standalone Product schemas.
  • Feature: Added Global Automatic Schemas for site-wide BreadcrumbList and front-page WebSite + Organization structured data.
  • Feature: Added per-post “Indexing & Robots” metabox tab for noindex, nofollow, and Custom Canonical URL, with automatic exclusion from sitemap.xml and IndexNow.
  • Feature: Added “JSON-LD Preview & Test” metabox tab with formatted code view, one-click clipboard copy, and direct link to Google Rich Results Test.
  • Feature: Added automatic 301 redirect creation when a published post’s URL slug changes, including loop prevention and redirect chain flattening.
  • Feature: Added one-click “Create Redirect” action in the 404 Error Monitor and bulk CSV Import/Export in Redirections Manager.
  • Feature: Added Manual URL Submission in IndexNow to ping any site URL on demand.
  • Feature: Added Sitemap content filters (Post Types & Taxonomies), automatic regeneration on post unpublish/trash, and toggle to disable /wp-sitemap.xml.
  • Feature: Added smart “Auto-Fill Empty with Clean Titles” button in the Alt Text Audit tool.
  • Feature: Added Crawl Budget & <head> Optimization tools (attachment page redirects, noindex internal search results, <head> cleanup, and comment feed disabling).
  • Improvement: Redesigned Redirections Manager and IndexNow admin screens with modern, responsive card layouts.
  • Improvement: Added automatic database table migration check on plugin updates and full cleanup via uninstall.php.
  • Update: Tested up to WordPress 7.1.5.

1.3.0

  • Feature: Added IndexNow protocol integration for instant search engine indexing pings.
  • Feature: Added a lightning-fast Redirections Manager to handle 301 and 302 redirects.
  • Improvement: Prevent duplicate IndexNow pings during rapid Gutenberg saves using caching.

1.2.1

  • Feature: Added a dismissible admin notice to request plugin reviews and support continuous development.
  • Update: Tested up to WordPress version 7.0.

1.2.0

  • Feature: Refactored Tools submenu into a tabbed interface.
  • Feature: Added 404 Error Monitor with dedicated database log to track missing pages.
  • Feature: Added Alt Text Audit tool to identify and batch-update missing image alt attributes.
  • Improvement: Codebase optimized to fully comply with strict WordPress coding standards.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added “Tools” submenu with utilities to refresh permalinks safely and clear expired database transients.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for Article, Product, Recipe, Review, FAQPage, and Local Business schemas.
  • WooCommerce Product schema enrichment (brand, GTIN, MPN, item condition).
  • Dynamic XML Sitemap generator using WP_Filesystem with auto-regeneration on post save.
  • Robots.txt Manager using WP_Filesystem with inline editor and Google-spec default template.
  • Modern admin UI with toggle switches, card-based layout, and full-width editor for file management pages.
